verdict_rationale: No BLOCKER. No MAJOR. One MINOR (I-AA-011 incomplete propagation of cycle-2 I-AA-004 fix into ADR-0047 prose at three additional lines outside the dispatch's scoped 'Amend line 14' edit). Two INFO (I-AA-012 audit-positive on I-AA-001 user-acceptance documentation completeness; I-AA-013 audit-positive on regression check). Per severity rules in KB-review-disciplines/references/severity-taxonomy.md: 'No critical; only recommended → Consistency > 90 AND Completeness > 85 AND no rule violations → APPROVED.' Generalizing to this auditor's BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR/INFO mapping: no BLOCKER and no MAJOR → no `fail`; only one MINOR (a residual prose inconsistency within a single ADR's body, mechanical to fix, severity-bounded to 'recommended' equivalent) → verdict can be `pass` rather than `conditional_pass`. The MINOR finding alone is below the verdict threshold for `fail` per the prior cycle's severity rule (BLOCKER → fail; MAJOR without BLOCKER → conditional_pass; only MINOR/INFO → pass). I-AA-011 is mechanical, localized to a single ADR file (ADR-0047), and is the same class of issue I-AA-004 — the propagation is incomplete but not divergent. Recommended: advance to Plan Authoring (Stage 9). I-AA-011 may be folded into a separate ADR-0047-only revision dispatch if the user wants ADR-0047 internally consistent before Gate 4 ratification, or deferred to acceptance with rationale (the ADR's frontmatter applies_to + Decision §5 — the load-bearing fields for the audit-trail — are five-firsts-consistent; only narrative prose is four-firsts).
